provenance.note: Mumbai's rivers and lakes basin atlas (scope mumbai-rivers; the city's own scope id 'mumbai' is the MMR region). Catchment joins (shedId) come from sub-hydrosheds.geojson, whose city half is the reviewed pipeline input pipeline-inputs/mumbai-river-catchments-fabdem.geojson (FABDEM + WhiteboxTools); CPCB stretch and station figures are read from the reviewed national table pipeline-inputs/atlas/prs/cpcb-2025.json. FABDEM lineage makes the catchment-joined families CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial) encumbered.

properties.name: Framji Cowasji Tank
properties.details: Philanthropic tank near the Esplanade, filled in as the fort glacis was cleared.
properties.locationBasis: Site opposite Metro Cinema at the Dhobi Talao junction; commemorative plaque survives
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Cowasji Patel Tank
properties.details: Filled in the late 19th century; the C.P. Tank locality is named after it.
properties.locationBasis: Site is today's C.P. Tank Circle, Bhuleshwar/Girgaon
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Gowalia Tank
properties.details: Drained; the site is now August Kranti Maidan.
properties.locationBasis: Site is today's August Kranti Maidan, Grant Road West
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Babula Tank
properties.details: Filled in; survives as Babula Tank Road.
properties.locationBasis: Survives as Babula Tank Road along JJ Hospital's western wall
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Mumbadevi Tank
properties.details: The old tank beside the Mumbadevi temple, filled in the 1870s-80s.
properties.locationBasis: Tank fronted the surviving Mumbadevi Temple, Bhuleshwar; filled 1890s
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Dhobi Talao
properties.details: Filled; the Dhobi Talao junction keeps the name.
properties.locationBasis: Locality name survives at the Metro Cinema junction
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Two Tanks (Do Tanki)
properties.details: Paired tanks filled in; survives as the Do Tanki locality.
properties.locationBasis: Now the Do Tanki junction, Maulana Azad Rd; 'Two Tanks' bus stop survives
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Khara Talao
properties.details: Brackish tank near Null Bazaar, filled in.
properties.locationBasis: Survives as Khara Tank Road, Kumbharwada near Null Bazaar
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Cavel Tank
properties.locationBasis: Cavel village locality centroid, Kalbadevi; no surviving marker
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Nawab Tank
properties.locationBasis: Survives as Nawab Tank Road, Mazgaon; site now a playground
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Bandra Talao (Lake)
properties.details: Surviving tank near Bandra, much reduced and encroached.
properties.locationBasis: Still exists as Swami Vivekanand Sarovar, S.V. Road, Bandra West
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Masjid Bandar tanks
properties.details: Cluster of small tanks largely lost to dense built fabric.
properties.locationBasis: Locality centroid at Masjid railway station; one spring-fed tank survives in the Jama Masjid courtyard
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)

properties.name: Pydhonie tank
properties.details: The 'foot-washing' tank that gave Pydhonie its name; long since built over.
properties.source: Dwivedi & Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995); Sahapedia; Tindall (1982)
